name: Creative Studio Scout
tagline: Finds hands-on workshops in pottery, glass, jewelry and cooking, at home or away
description: A scout for people who would rather make something than look at something. It digs up hands-on classes in pottery, glass, jewelry and cooking near home or wherever you are traveling, and comes back with dates, prices and booking links, so one evening of curiosity can become a booked seat.
author: vidales_nataly
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
